title: A lifted quotient presentation presents an extension as a cokernel
statement: Let D be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Suppose 0→M --i→ E --p→ N→0 and 0→K --k→ P --q→ N→0 are short exact sequences. For every l:P→E with l≫p=q there is g:K→M with g≫i=k≫l, and E is isomorphic to the cokernel of the map K→M⊕P with components -g and k.

source.place: Tag 093U, lemma-kernel-finite-locally-constant (3), a lifted quotient presentation presents an extension as a cokernel

proof.text: Since k l p=k q=0, the kernel property of i gives a unique g with g i=k l. Put a=(-g,k) and b=(i,l). The biproduct identities give a b=0.
Prove b epi by cancellation against maps to zero. A map t killing b kills i, so the cokernel property of p gives t=p d. It also kills l, hence q d=l p d=l t=0. Since q is epi, d=0 and t=0.

Prove a is a kernel of b. Its second component k is mono, so a is mono. If z:Z→M⊕P satisfies z b=0, its second component is killed by q, hence factors uniquely as w k. The equation z b=0, the relation g i=k l, and monicity of i force its first component to be -w g. Thus z=w a, uniquely.
In an abelian category an epi is a cokernel of its kernel. Apply this to b and a, and compare with the chosen cokernel of a to obtain E≅coker(a).

theorem exists_cokernel_presentation_of_lift {D : Type u} [Category.{v} D] [Abelian D]
    {M E N K P : D} (i : M ⟶ E) (p : E ⟶ N) (k : K ⟶ P) (q : P ⟶ N)
    (hip : i ≫ p = 0) (hkq : k ≫ q = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk i p hip).ShortExact)
    (hT : (ShortComplex.mk k q hkq).ShortExact)
    (l : P ⟶ E) (hl : l ≫ p = q) :
    ∃ g : K ⟶ M, g ≫ i = k ≫ l ∧
      Nonempty (E ≅ cokernel (biprod.lift (-g) k))
